01 / THE NEW VISION

YOUR ART DESERVES MORE.

An opening lasts an evening. An artist's journey lasts much longer. We replace the isolated event with an active, year-long relationship: someone to exchange ideas with, create with and turn to when new possibilities arise.

MADS
MEDIATOR · ADVISOR · DEALER · SEEKER
02 / WHAT YOUR YEAR INCLUDES

ONE YEAR.
A WHOLE ECOSYSTEM.

A flexible artist advisory project, shaped around your needs, your creative rhythm and your professional goals.

01 / HUMAN CONNECTION

Your Art Curator

A creative professional to talk to, develop ideas with and navigate your artistic path alongside.

02 / REPRESENTATION

Your Gallery, By Your Side

Professional mediation, guidance and handling of artistic enquiries within our agreed representation role.

03 / PERSONAL SPACE

Your Own Landing Page

A dedicated artist destination within our redesigned interactive website: your identity, works and evolving story.

04 / CONTINUOUS ART PRESENCE

Your Art, Always Present

A continuous presentation of your work within the Triennale’s immersive digital environment. Not a one-off exhibition, not a scheduled opening: a living presence that evolves with your art.

05 / ONGOING STORYTELLING

Social & Editorial Support

New works, series and ideas can enter an evolving curatorial and multimedia communication flow, even several times in a week when appropriate.

06 / NEXT OPPORTUNITIES

Professional Connections

Support in preparing and presenting your work to suitable curators, galleries and art organisations when opportunities arise.

05 / THE GRAND FINALE

A DIGITAL JOURNEY.
A PHYSICAL FINALE.

The Triennale culminates in a major international physical event in 2029. Participation in the Grand Finale is included even if you join for only one annual programme.
